## Scope and verified state

**Draft / IN_PROGRESS — six of twenty issues have local original acceptance and separate quality acceptance: #2, #3, #5, #6, #8, and #11. This is not whole-roadmap completion, M0 completion, a deployed investigation, CI acceptance, merge authorization, or SHIPPED.** The coordinator performs orchestration, evidence observation, and exact-path Git integration; workers author implementation.

- **#3:** qualified licensed financial-original route, precise Microsoft/Amazon spans and retained CC0 originals; source rights and bounded acquisition are recorded, not internet-wide coverage.
- **#5:** actual native Brain qualification with owner/denied roles, append-only conflicting records, exact spans, restart/recall/history and concurrency. The fourth authorized continuation is retained with earlier failures; no fifth qualifier. Document relationships are not financial-transaction proof.
- **#6:** real dated frontier-economics pack and assessment, strongest counterevidence, explicit assumptions/invalidation conditions and inspectable precise revision. Missing financial quantities remain unknown.
- **#8:** three structurally distinct explorers over the same real pack. Felipe chose guided questions first, followed by evidence and missing premises, retaining relationship/timeline lenses. Actual desktop/narrow-reader and keyboard-focus receipts cover all variants; the unchanged relationship prototype default is not a claim that production #9 is integrated.
- **#11:** attention/activity/adoption/capability semantics and honest descriptive evaluator; coverage is not accuracy or truth probability.

These are local issue acceptance checkpoints, not authority to close upstream issues. Complete original acceptance, independent quality, source provenance, and claim-span reports are retained under `.genie/wishes/open-intelligence-observatory/`.

- **#4 remains unaccepted:** the one actual zero-model startup failed before native metadata/catalog completion. Static full-Bookworm ELF availability is only a compatible-prerequisite candidate, not SDK/loader/startup proof. The owner approved only a reviewed native-extension architecture proposal for the missing completion, all-transport principal, atomic-stop, and total-spend contracts—not implementation or another runtime attempt.
- **#9 and #13** depend on actual accepted #7; assistant/publication/collection/community/expansion/queue/CI work follows the unchanged native DAG. No dependency-ready label substitutes for acceptance.
- Fresh product credential custody is qualified privately; it is not paid admission. Product model calls: **0**. Approved shared validation cap remains **USD20 total (DSH12 / Brain8)**; coding/storage/all-cost totals remain **UNKNOWN**. Enforced currency/usage reservations, attributable editorial/newcomer approval, recurring collection and deployment authority remain real gates.
